_about: Combat feel (lane P1), read by CombatFeel.cs. scope: 'player' = only the PlayerBrain fighter uses the cancel table + press queue (the AI keeps its tuned S5 timings); 'all' = both. input.strikeFire: 'down' (default, Strategy decision) = the light/stab fires on key-DOWN; holding the key past holdToHeavyMs while still inside the wind-up (tick <= holdToHeavyUntilTick) cancels into the heavy; G = heavy | 'release' = V3 (a tap fires on key-UP, ~60-110 ms late; hold heavyHoldSeconds = heavy). queue: a press made while a move / dodge / stagger runs stays alive for (ticks left in that state + extraTicks), capped at maxTicks, so it runs at the earliest legal tick and is never eaten. rows: cancel windows out of Recovery: move ('*' = any) , to (roll|sidestep|backstep|guard|light|heavy|thrust|kick|special), earliest = Recovery tick t (1 = first tick after the active window; recovery lengths: light 22, thrust 21, heavy 31, kick 25), -1 = never, onHitOnly = only when the swing connected (hit confirm). No row for an attack = it runs when the recovery ends (or via the move's own chain window). Old rule without this file: dodges after half the recovery.
